scenarios.name: Apply and restore a body appearance

scenario_steps.name: a part with a visible solid body is active in the MCAD Software
the body appearance is set to As Part
the user opens Body Properties for the body from the model browser
the user selects Black in Body Appearance
the solid is displayed with the Black appearance
the user reopens Body Properties for the same body
the user selects As Part in Body Appearance
the solid is displayed with the part appearance
